name: Giới thiệu bản thân
description: Bắt đầu cuộc trò chuyện bằng những điều về bạn.

words.example: My hometown is a small coastal city.
I work for a software company.

name: Gia đình & bạn bè
description: Kể về những người quan trọng trong cuộc sống.

words.example: My mother works at a school.
We visit our relatives during Tet.
She's a close friend of mine.
I get along with my coworkers.
I spend time with my family on Sundays.
My grandparents live in the countryside.
My cousin is visiting this weekend.

name: Một ngày của bạn
description: Từ lúc thức dậy đến khi đi ngủ.

words.example: I get up a little later on Sundays.
I brush my teeth twice a day.
I take a shower before breakfast.
I go to work by bus.
I go to bed before eleven.
I always carry a water bottle.
I get dressed after my shower.

name: Sở thích & giải trí
description: Nói về những điều khiến bạn thấy vui.

words.example: What do you do in your free time?
I listen to music on the bus.
We watch movies on Friday nights.
I play games with my friends.
I like to read books before bed.
I relax by listening to music.
We go hiking once a month.
I take photos when I travel.

name: Cảm xúc & ý kiến
description: Diễn đạt cảm giác và điều bạn nghĩ.

words.example: I think this is a good idea.

name: Ăn uống & gọi món
description: Tự tin gọi món và nói về món ăn yêu thích.

words.example: I'd like to order some noodles.
Could we have the bill, please?
I'd like a bowl of noodles.
Can I order this for takeaway?

name: Nhà cửa & việc nhà
description: Chuyện quanh nhà, từ nấu ăn đến dọn dẹp.

words.example: I clean my room every week.
I do the laundry on Saturdays.

name: Mua sắm & tiền bạc
description: Hỏi giá, thử đồ và thanh toán.

words.example: I want to buy a new bag.
What is the price of this shirt?
I'd like to pay by card.
Do you have this in my size?
Can I try on this jacket?
I can't afford a new phone yet.

name: Sức khỏe
description: Mô tả triệu chứng và đặt lịch khám.

words.example: I have pain in my back.
I've had a cough for two days.
Do I need to take this medicine with food?
I'd like to see a doctor.
I have an appointment at ten.
I hope you feel better soon.

name: Đi lại & hỏi đường
description: Tìm đường và sử dụng phương tiện công cộng.

words.example: The bus stop is across the street.
Turn left at the next street.
The hotel is near the park.
Is the airport far from here?
Get off at the next stop.
Cross the street at the lights.
There's a lot of traffic today.
The cafe is opposite the bank.
How do I get to the museum?

name: Làm quen & chuyện trò
description: Giữ cuộc trò chuyện tự nhiên với người mới.

words.example: I'm doing well. How about you?
What do you do for a living?
Dinner at seven? That sounds good.
I have to go. See you later!
Long time no see! How are you?
By the way, where are you staying?

name: Hẹn gặp & lên kế hoạch
description: Sắp xếp một cuộc hẹn thật dễ dàng.

words.example: We need to cancel the meeting.
What time works for you tomorrow?
I'd like to invite you to dinner.
Would you like to join us?
I'm looking forward to our trip.
Sorry, I can't make it tonight.

name: Du lịch & khách sạn
description: Từ sân bay đến nhận phòng khách sạn.

words.example: We need to leave for the airport.
Where can I collect my luggage?
I'd like to book a room.
I have a reservation under Nguyen.

words.meaning: làm thủ tục nhận phòng, lên máy bay
words.example: What time can we check in?
We need to check out before noon.
Can I see your boarding pass?

name: Nhờ giúp đỡ & lịch sự
description: Những câu nhỏ tạo nên cuộc trò chuyện dễ chịu.

words.example: Can you help me with this bag?
Thanks for your time. I appreciate it.
Excuse me, is this seat taken?
Never mind, I found my keys.
Would you mind closing the door?
That's okay. We can try again.
Take your time. There's no rush.

name: Giải thích & hiểu nhau
description: Hỏi lại và làm rõ khi bạn chưa hiểu.

words.example: There's a problem with my order.

words.meaning: có nghĩa là, có ý là

words.example: I'm not sure about the time.
Could you say that again, please?

words.meaning: bạn nói chậm hơn được không
words.example: Could you speak more slowly, please?
What do you mean by that?
I meant next Friday, not today.
There was a misunderstanding about the date.
You can bring fruit, for example, apples.
In other words, we need more time.

name: Công việc & trách nhiệm
description: Giới thiệu vai trò và những việc bạn phụ trách.

words.example: What is your role on the team?
This task will take an hour.
You'll be responsible for customer support.

words.meaning: làm việc dưới sự quản lý của
words.example: I report to the sales manager.
Who is in charge of this project?
I work in the marketing department.
She works part-time at a cafe.
I work remotely twice a week.

name: Trao đổi với đồng nghiệp
description: Nhờ kiểm tra, gửi tài liệu và xác nhận thông tin.

words.example: Could you send me the file?
I'll share the document with you.
Could you confirm the meeting time?
The file is attached to the email.
Let me know if you need help.

words.meaning: bạn kiểm tra giúp tôi được không
words.example: Could you check this before I send it?
Could you forward that email to me?

words.meaning: liên hệ lại, theo dõi tiếp
words.example: I'll follow up with the client tomorrow.
Are you available for a call now?

words.meaning: cập nhật tình hình cho tôi
words.example: Please keep me updated on the project.

name: Họp & trình bày ý kiến
description: Đóng góp ý kiến và thống nhất quyết định.

words.meaning: nội dung cần bàn trong cuộc họp

words.example: We need to discuss the budget.
I suggest starting with a small test.
I have a question about the deadline.
We need to make a decision today.
In my opinion, this option is better.
What do you think about this plan?
I'll take notes during the meeting.
Can I bring up one more issue?
Let me summarize what we agreed on.

name: Tiến độ & thời hạn
description: Báo tiến độ, xử lý sự cố và quản lý thời gian.

words.example: Do you have an update for us?
We found an issue in the report.
We need to resolve this issue.
I need more time to check the data.
What's the due date for this task?

name: Khách hàng & dịch vụ
description: Hiểu nhu cầu và giải quyết yêu cầu của khách.

words.example: The customer needs help with an order.

words.meaning: khách hàng sử dụng dịch vụ

words.example: Thank you for using our service.

words.meaning: tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn
words.example: Hello, how can I help you?
I'd like to make a complaint.
You can contact our support team.
Are you satisfied with the result?
We can send you a replacement.
This item is still in stock.
Sorry, that item is out of stock.
Could you send us a quote?

name: Phỏng vấn & sự nghiệp
description: Nói về kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng và mục tiêu.

words.example: I have three years of experience.
I want to improve my communication skills.
I'd like to apply for a job here.

words.meaning: sơ yếu lý lịch nghề nghiệp

words.example: What qualifications does the role require?
Tell me about your biggest achievement.
I want to build a career in design.
She received a promotion last month.
We're planning to hire two developers.

name: Học tập & lớp học
description: Hỏi bài, học kỹ năng mới và trao đổi trong lớp.

words.example: My English class starts at six.
I need to finish my homework.
My listening is starting to improve.
I have an exam next week.
I got a good grade on the test.
I need to learn more vocabulary.

name: Công nghệ & internet
description: Những từ cần dùng khi làm việc với thiết bị.

words.example: Please log in to your account.
You can download the file here.
Our website has a new design.
I need to install this app.
You can change it in settings.
Remember to back up your files.

name: Thời tiết & mùa
description: Một cách dễ dàng để mở đầu cuộc trò chuyện.

words.example: It's too windy for a picnic.
The weather is warm in spring.
Have you checked the weather forecast?
I love the colors of autumn.
It gets cold here in winter.

name: Quần áo & phong cách
description: Mô tả trang phục và tìm món đồ phù hợp.

words.example: I need a white shirt for work.
I need a new pair of socks.
What should I wear to the party?
We can wear casual clothes on Fridays.

name: Thể thao & vận động
description: Nói về tập luyện và hoạt động ngoài trời.

words.example: I go running in the park.
I'm going to the gym tonight.
I work out three times a week.
I hope our team will win.
We don't want to lose this game.
I want to improve my fitness.

name: Ngân hàng & tài chính cá nhân
description: Nói về chi tiêu, tiết kiệm và giao dịch.

words.example: I'd like to open a bank account.
I need to withdraw some cash.
I'd like to make a deposit.
I'm using my savings for this trip.
We need to stay within our budget.
How can I check my balance?
I'm trying to pay off my debt.
Could you lend me ten dollars?
What is the exchange rate today?

name: Mối quan hệ & kết nối
description: Quan tâm, chia sẻ và giữ liên lạc với nhau.

words.example: I need someone to listen to me.
We sometimes argue about small things.
I want to apologize for being late.
I hope you can forgive me.
Thanks for being patient with me.
It's normal to miss someone you love.
I'd like to get to know you better.
It's nice to have something in common.

name: Sự cố & tình huống khẩn cấp
description: Diễn đạt rõ khi bạn cần giúp đỡ ngay.

words.example: We need to contact the police.
I'm lost. Can you help me?
There's a fire in the building.

name: Văn hóa & lễ hội
description: Chia sẻ phong tục và những dịp đặc biệt.

words.example: Do you have plans for the holiday?
I brought you a small gift.
We're going to a wedding on Saturday.
Can you tell me about this custom?
I'd like to try some local food.
We decorate the house for Tet.
We wear this on a special occasion.
My wish is to travel with my family.
